tools.description: Calculates a natal (birth) chart with the Swiss Ephemeris: the exact sign, degree and house of the Sun, Moon, planets, North Node and Chiron; the Ascendant, MC, DSC and IC; the 12 house cusps; and the major aspects between the planets with their orbs. tools.name: transits_today
tools.description: Lists the tight transits of a given day to a natal chart: aspects of the transiting Moon, Sun, Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter and Saturn to the natal planets, Ascendant and MC within 2° (3° for Jupiter and Saturn), plus each planet's current sign and natal house and the Moon phase. tools.name: vedic_chart
tools.description: Calculates a Vedic (Jyotish) birth chart with the Swiss Ephemeris: sidereal zodiac with the Lahiri ayanamsa, whole-sign houses from the Lagna (Ascendant), the rashi, degree and house of the nine grahas (Sun to Saturn, Rahu as the mean node and Ketu opposite), and the nakshatra, pada and nakshatra lo

tools.name: vimshottari_dasha
tools.description: Calculates the Vimshottari dasha periods of a birth chart (Swiss Ephemeris, Lahiri ayanamsa): the Moon's nakshatra at birth, the balance of the first Mahadasha, the full Mahadasha sequence from birth with start and end dates, and the Mahadasha, Antardasha and Pratyantardasha running on a given date

tools.name: sky_today
tools.description: Returns the sky of one calendar day from the Swiss Ephemeris: the Moon's sign, phase and illumination, lunations and eclipses, planet sign changes, retrograde/direct stations, exact aspects between planets, which planets are retrograde, and every planet's position, plus a link to the AstralRead 'Sky

tools.name: kb_lookup
tools.description: Finds pages of the AstralRead astrology knowledge base for a chart factor and returns each page's title, a one- or two-sentence summary and its link. tools.name: my_charts
tools.description: Lists the birth charts saved in the signed-in user's AstralRead account: the label (e.g. «Me», a partner's name), birth date, time and city, with the chart_id the other account tools take. Requires signing in to AstralRead.

tools.name: my_chart
tools.description: Returns one saved chart of the signed-in user: the natal placements (Swiss Ephemeris) and the personal AstralRead reading written for it, plus the latest questions and answers. Use it to answer questions about the user's own chart without asking for birth data.

tools.name: my_transits
tools.description: The tight transits of a day (default today) to one saved chart of the signed-in user — no birth data needed. Same calculation as transits_today.

tools.name: ask_astrologer
tools.description: Asks the AstralRead astrologer a question about one saved chart of the signed-in user — the same astrologer as on astralread.com: the chart, the current transits and classic astrology and psychology books. Uses one question of the user's AstralRead plan; the answer is also saved in the chart's chat
